text:
emily: @channel :tada: Shipping GA for the new Hosted Streaming Lite Gateway (service: host/stream-lite). Purpose: low-latency mobile/web streaming path optimized for short chats and lightweight tool-calls. Docs + migration guide: https://redwood.internal/docs/stream-lite-ga (internal). Rolling to hosted clusters over the next 48h. Read the notes below and ping me with any blockers.

raj: Awesome — congrats team! Quick Q: any auth or quota changes we should warn customers about?

emily: No auth changes — same API key model. Default per-org quota for stream-lite is slightly conservative for GA (1k rps). Customers can request quota bumps via #sales-support or the partner portal.

sarah: Adding a couple of quick-start snippets here for devs.

sarah: ```bash
# streaming-lite curl example
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -N \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream-lite?model=mosaic-lite\" \n  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \n  -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Hey"}]}'
```

sarah: Node example (SDK coming in next patch):

sarah: ```js
const res = await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream-lite?model=mosaic-lite', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${process.env.REDWOOD_KEY}`, 'Accept': 'text/event-stream' },
  body: JSON.stringify({ messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Hello' }] })
});
for await (const chunk of res.body) {
  process.stdout.write(chunk);
}
```

jamal: Ops/SRE notes: we'll start a canary in us-west-2 and us-east-1. Target SLO for GA initial rollout: p95 first-token latency < 120ms, error rate < 0.5%. I'm updating runbooks and pager thresholds now.

alice: Is there a deprecation plan for /v1/realtime or the old streaming endpoint? Customers on realtime will need migration docs.

emily: Not immediate. Old /v1/realtime remains supported. We'll maintain both paths until end of Q3 to give teams time to migrate. We will publish a formal deprecation timeline in two weeks and notify major customers directly.

deploy-bot: Deployed host/stream-lite v1.0 to canary clusters at 2141593000 by emily.

raj: Who should engineering teams ping if they hit functional regressions during their migration?

emily: Ping #eng-runtime and @sarah (devex) for onboarding help. Critical issues: escalate to @jamal and #eng-oncall.

sarah: Onboarding session scheduled: Tomorrow 10:00 PT — RSVP: https://cal.example.com/stream-lite-onboard (internal). Recording will be posted.

jamal: Heads-up to SRE oncall: please monitor stream-lite errors and latency dashboards during the next 48h rollout and escalate if error spikes > 0.5% or p95 > 200ms. Tagging @sre-oncall here. :eyes:

sre-oncall: Oncall acked. I'll instrument an alert rule for increased ERROR logs + latency regression and keep #incidents looped in.

emily: Thanks everyone — big thanks to eng-runtime + infra + devex for getting this over the finish line. We'll post an internal TL;DR and an external customer email template later today. :party:
